messages:
support_sara: FYI AcmeFin escalated — p99 on /v1/text.generate jumped around 03:00 UTC, SLA violation. Dashboard shows p99 from ~1.2s -> 2.8s in last 15m. Histogram panel still shows most traffic under 1s. Customer seeing timeouts. Request ids: req-6f2a, req-6f2b. Paging oncall :eyes:
eng_sre_mike: On it. Do we have the exact dashboard queries? Could be a calculation mismatch (histogram_quantile vs summary/t-digest).
telemetry_ana: I pulled the panels — the main p99 card uses this PromQL:```histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/text.generate",env="prod"}[5m])) by (le))```The histogram panel is showing raw buckets; note we recently changed bucket boundaries in the agent rollout.
support_sara: Ah, we rolled bucket change last week? Customer only started complaining today.
infra_jin: We did push agent 2.1.7 that updates latency buckets to finer bins (0.1/0.25/0.5/0.75/1/2/5). Before it was coarse (0.5/1/2/5). There's a normalization step in the telemetry pipeline that should map old->new buckets, but I see a backlog and some partial merges. That could distort histogram_quantile results when aggregating across instances/regions.
eng_sre_mike: That explains the mismatch: histogram_quantile is sensitive to bucket boundaries. If some shards report old bucket schema and others new, the aggregated bucket counts get smeared and the quantile moves. Summary/t-digest based metrics wouldn't have that artifact.
product_ellie: Customer impact high — can we give AcmeFin a short explanation and an ETA for mitigation? They want whether this is a real latency regression or just metric noise.
telemetry_ana: Quick diagnostic: run this to compare summary vs histogram:```# t-digest summary quantile (telemetry v2)
quantile_over_time(0.99, request_duration_tdigest{route="/v1/text.generate",env="prod"}[5m])

# histogram_quantile from buckets
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/text.generate",env="prod"}[5m])) by (le))
```I can run both across the same timeframe. Initial check: summary-based shows ~1.1s, histogram_quantile shows ~2.7s.
eng_sre_mike: For immediate mitigation I can: 1) update Grafana panel to show the summary/t-digest quantile instead of histogram_quantile, and 2) add an annotation explaining bucket-rollout artifacts. Which do we prefer?
infra_jin: We should also throttle the normalization job so it finishes sooner for recent days — backlog is in the ingestion cluster. I can scale the worker pool for the merge job. But that's a longer fix (20–40m).
product_ellie: Tell AcmeFin: we believe it's a telemetry artifact caused by agent bucket schema mismatch. No backend change to request handling. ETA for visible fix: 15–30m if we switch dashboard to t-digest. Please escalate if that changes.
incident-bot: incident-bot: Created incident INC-2026-321 (p95/p99 dashboard discrepancy) and paged oncall.
eng_sre_mike: I'll flip the panel to use t-digest metric now and create a temporary dashboard that sources quantile_over_time on the summary metric. Also will pin an alternate p95 card for their route. Deploying change in 2min.
telemetry_ana: I ran the queries across regions — numbers consistent with summary. Backfill of normalized buckets still incomplete for last 6h; scaled workers should finish in ~25m after Jin's scale-up.
infra_jin: Scaling ingestion workers now (+3 pods). Watching backlog: 12k -> 800 in queue after one minute.
support_sara: Updated customer: "We see telemetry schema rollouts causing a mismatch between histogram-derived p99 and summary-derived p99. No production request latency regression detected; we're switching dashboards and completing telemetry normalization. We'll follow up in 30m."
product_ellie: Thanks. Also add a short runbook note: when agent bucket boundaries change, dashboards that use histogram_quantile must be validated or switched to t-digest/summary until normalization completes.
eng_sre_mike: Added runbook snippet and updated dashboard panels. Will leave both panels side-by-side for 2 hours. If backlog doesn't clear, I'll revert the agent change for the small fraction of hosts still on old schema.
telemetry_ana: Follow-ups: 1) add automated compatibility check to detect mixed bucket schemas for a metric, 2) flag Grafana panels that use histogram_quantile and offer alternative queries. I'll file tickets.
support_sara: Closing loop with AcmeFin now. Thanks team :thumbsup:
